hypothesis: Block cleanup is constant across the measured workload. Remaining cost variation may follow request-dictionary and finished-set sizes; these cardinalities also distinguish the batch states that block counts alone collapsed.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures the size of the request dictionary from which cleanup deletes an entry and provides distinct entry states across batch sizes.

pcvs.name: finished_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures the size of the set receiving the finished request ID, including variation associated with set growth.

pcvs.expression: sum((len(manager.req_to_blocks.get(request.request_id, ())) for manager in self.kv_cache_manager.coordinator.single_type_managers)) if not delay_free_blocks else 0
pcvs.name: allocated_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Retains the direct measure of block-release traversal work.
